notes.title: Lycoris Update
notes.notes: [p]The following functions have been improved.[/p][p]1- A new map was added[/p][p]2- All maps have been configured to be playable in all game modes.[/p][p]3- Some changes in the Main Menu UI[/p][p]4- A dynamic and easier UI was created for the Custom Map Mode, making it much easier to choose the Map you want to play.[/p][p]5- New Visuals.[/p][p]6- 3 new game modes have been added to Quick Match, which will be available soon along with a new UI which has already been integrated.[/p][p]7- New Songs Maps.[/p][p]8- Some maps have been optimized.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.[/p]

notes.title: Lycoris V2 Release
notes.notes:
[p]LYCORIS just Release V2![/p][p]New Features - Whats New?
[/p][p]1-Loadout System[/p][p]2-Primary/Secondary Weapon[/p][p]3-Weapon attachments[/p][p]4-Weapon Skins[/p][p]5-Lethal equipment (Grenade/Claymore)[/p][p]6-Perks[/p][p]7-Field Upgrades (e.g., an ammo box or a medkit)[/p][p]8-Lycoris Agents[/p][p]9-Character Selection system.[/p][p]10-New Rifle weapon added.[/p][p]11-New Killstreak: Cluster Strike.[/p][p]12-Procedural Aim Down Sights.[/p][p]13-Level-up System.[/p][p]14-Challenges/Missions System.[/p][p]-15Tactical Sprint.[/p][p]16-New Inspect weapon animations.[/p][p]17-New Tactical sprint animations.[/p][p]18-Assault Rifle animations reworked.[/p][p]19-New VFX (like muzzle flashes, bullet tracers, explosions, etc.).[/p][p]20-New Weapon sounds - using metasounds.[/p][p]21- Toons of New Menus ( User Interface ).


[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Lycoris Update
notes.notes:
The following functions have been improved.

1- The following maps have been optimized: MainMenu, Character Selection, OpenWorld
2- A new main menu has been added
3- The rifle's firing distance range has been improved, it was previously 2900, now it is 7000.
4- The pause menu has been improved

Together we will make Lycoris a better game.
Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.
